description: I ordered a SWAN boiler for 12300 UAH. NOVA POSHTA delivered it on 2025-10-17 in a sealed box and I did not open it at the branch. At home I found small holes from shrapnel in the box and the boiler tank is punctured. The boiler is damaged and unsafe, and I do not know whether it was hit at the SWAN warehouse or during delivery.
documentText: NOVA POSHTA waybill 20450987654321, sender SWAN warehouse Brovary, delivered 2025-10-17, parcel sealed. Photos: 4 photos of holes in the box and tank (not attached).
